channel.title: Antenne: Neorgon fleet news
channel.description: Launches, features, and fixes across the Neorgon fleet, approved at the desk before publishing

item.title: Aficion learns your ties
item.description: The atlas grows to 331 nodes and 22 clusters, levels become one Low-to-Hardcore dedication scale, and you can now tie your own links between nodes, note why, and link straight to any node.

item.title: Aficion opens the atlas
item.description: One connected map of 269 hobbies and the crafts underneath, drawn like a skill tree: mark what you practise, watch the gold paths join, and compare maps by link.

item.title: Every site gets one way home
item.description: The logo and the site title merged into a single link home, the favicon now takes its tint from whatever theme you picked, and the hub has its own planet icon in the header.

item.title: Echeance watches the clock
item.description: Echeance tracks when tokens and credentials expire, and what the renewal actually takes for each one. The renewal steps live next to the date, because the date alone never helped anybody.

item.title: Balise collects the corrections
item.description: Spotted something wrong on a Neorgon site? Balise takes the report. It collects corrections raised from anywhere in the fleet, triages them behind a private desk, and keeps a public record of what got fixed.

item.title: Four sites open in one day
item.description: Releve, Scalpel, Enjeu and Cadrage all went live on the same day. A transcript pricer, a skill dissector, a print-and-play boss rush, and a camera settings trainer.

item.title: Resume Forge opens its second wave
item.description: The delivery board is open again: Resume Forge is getting a second campaign, with contracts frozen and workstreams assigned.

item.title: Four sites take French names
item.description: Gambit is now Gamme, Stake is Enjeu, TickBox is Carnet, Rigcheck is Cadrage. One live domain moved, and the old one redirects.

item.title: Dispatch is live
item.description: The fleet gets a front page. Launches, features, and fixes land here as short stories, each one approved at the desk before it ships.

item.title: Stake deals itself in
item.description: The print-and-play boss rush for one player, one die, and the bricks you own is now a registered fleet site. Rules, printable cards, an on-screen runner, and a balance simulator are on the way to stake.neorgon.com.

item.title: The Header Kit counts arrivals right again
item.description: The shared header's arrival pattern now counts #s= hashes, so deep links into a site register the way plain visits do.

item.title: Pixeldoll joins the fleet
item.description: Build a 16x16 pixel character in the browser, then meet it again in Floorplan: the my-character cookie carries your doll across the fleet.

item.title: One tiny pixel person, every site
item.description: The Neorgon Avatar Kit lands: 16x16 characters with tiers, share codes, and a fleet-wide cookie, vendored to sites the same way the header and footer kits are.

item.title: Fleet avatars learn to walk
item.description: The Avatar Kit gains three walk frames, and Floorplan's Sim mode uses them to send little people strolling around your team map.

item.title: Slides learns to check its own exports
item.description: Exporting a deck now produces a receipt showing what actually made it into the file, plus a contrast check on brand colour pairs and a measured fit rather than a guess.

item.title: The hub learns to forget
item.description: The hub now archives tools it has superseded and keeps reference material out of the What is New surfaces, so the front page shows what actually changed rather than everything that exists.

item.title: The fleet grows a safety net
item.description: Every site now ships a 404 page, adopts a shared ignore base, and gets checked by a suite that runs in CI. The interesting part is which checks were added, because each one exists because something slipped through.

item.title: Mosaic joins the fleet
item.description: Mosaic builds photo collages that stay editable. Change the grid, the shape or the column count whenever you like, and the photos you already placed stay where they are.
